Title: Collectio confessionum in ecclesiis reformatis publicatarum
Creator: Hermann Agathon Niemeyer (editor)
Publisher: Lipsiae: J. Klinkhardt, 1840
Publication Date: 1840
Rights: Public Domain (published 1840; pd-us-by-date)
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item collectioconfes00niemgoog, file collectioconfes00niemgoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: archive.org possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT; scan from Harvard University digitised by Google.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from no characters changed. Rights basis: the imprint year 1840 is 1930 or earlier, so the work is public domain by the project's date rule.
Content note: A collection of Reformed and related confessions in Latin, with some German texts, and the editor's Latin introductions. The Bohemian material is: the editor's note on the Bohemian confessions (file line 4055); the Confession of the Bohemian barons and nobles of 1535, headed 'Additamentum 2' (preface to Ferdinand from about file line 47905, running head 'Confessio Bohoemica', text to about line 49840); and the Confessio Bohemica of 1575 (Latin, Frankfurt 1619 printing), headed 'Additamentum 3' from file line 49843. The collection also holds the Consensus of Sendomir (1570, between the Brethren, Lutherans and Reformed of Poland) from line 36111 and the Confessio Czengerina from line 35480. OCR sampled at five points (10/30/50/70/90 percent): Latin is readable with systematic letter-level misreads (o for e, c for e, 'Bohoemica' for Bohemica); the 50 percent point falls in a German blackletter text and is garbled. Treat as a second witness: check every wording against the page image.
